raw: {"verdict": "warn", "note": "Changing EVAL_SHARD to 0 makes the evaluation use shard 0, which is part of TRAIN_SHARDS ('0-9'), so val_bpb would be measured on training data instead of the fixed held-out val shard and no longer reflect real model quality."}

parsed.note: Changing EVAL_SHARD to 0 makes the evaluation use shard 0, which is part of TRAIN_SHARDS ('0-9'), so val_bpb would be measured on training data instead of the fixed held-out val shard and no longer reflect real model quality.
